|| `spread` | **Type**: `std::optional<double>`
Minimal gap between the maximal and the minimal per-worker usage of the resource (in the resource's own units: cores for CPU, bytes for memory) from which the load counts as uneven. ||
|| `ratio` | **Type**: `std::optional<double>`
